mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right floor plan for my multigenerational family?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right floor plan involves carefully considering each family member's needs, privacy preferences, and daily routines. Assess how many private bedrooms and bathrooms are required, whether shared common areas should be larger, and if separate entrances or kitchenettes are beneficial. Think about long-term accessibility, such as wider doorways or roll-in showers. Our design team can guide you through options that optimize space for shared living while maintaining individual comfort and independence.
